'''Sallinor Parova''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who replaced [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] as [[Chief of Naval Operations]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. In [[44 ABY]], she also became a conspirator in a [[Lecersen Conspiracy|dual coup]] against the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the Galactic Alliance. She was later kidnapped by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Rynog Asokaji]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], and [[Bwua'tu]] and taken to the Jedi Temple where they interrogated her. After she refused to tell them anything, she was killed by members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] who had occupied the Temple.
